entities.contents: {\LNotes:}  \P\pxi-1,l1;1. Each Tube in the distribution cable shall contain 2 monitoring cores,it shall go through the whole link in this tube until the last  FAT which it  monitor.such fiber shall be directly spliced to the feeder cable. \P2. Such 2 monitoring cores shall be interconnected at the last FAT which it monitors.  \P3. Each FAT contains 1 service core and 1 expansion core, each service core shall be spliced in the FAT which it serves. \P4. This fiber configuration shall be applied to all types of the distribution cable which shall be used in the project. \P5. If here 72c main FO cable meet with 36c branch FO cable insider cluster,for 36c cable two tubes(6C/T) shall be combined  into one tube(12C/T) to match with the 72c main cable,\P    the splicing sequence shall be complied above drawing.\P6. Each FAT will be provided 1 pigtail with SC/APC for splicing and testing in first installation,the detail installation for pigtail and splitter(1:8) will be included in CPE section.\P7.The detail informations of FDT tray splicing are already included in FDT layout drawing{\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;.}
